climate.koppen_name: Temperate, no dry season, warm summer

land: Faces the midday sun. In a climate this cool, that extra warmth is often what gets grapes fully ripe.

blurb.text: A Côte de Beaune appellation in the Côte d'Or, grouped under Puligny-Montrachet, for wine made only from Chardonnay. Its vineyards are shared between the communes of Chassagne-Montrachet and Puligny-Montrachet. Puligny-Montrachet itself makes almost only white wine.
